title: test(app-shell,console): inherit the real surface in @object-ui/auth vi.mock factories
body:
Part of #6892 — slice 3 of the per-specifier `vi.mock` sweep worklist: `@object-ui/auth`, the largest block on it by a factor of three.

All 102 frozen factories on `@object-ui/auth` now obtain the real module and spread it before their overrides, and the specifier joins `COVERED_SPECIFIERS` in `scripts/check-vi-mock-inherit.mjs` in the same PR — the gate's documented widening precondition.

> Generic type arguments below are spelled as CAPITALISED WORDS rather than in angle brackets, because GitHub's body sanitizer silently deletes tag-shaped fragments — including inside backticks and fenced blocks (AGENTS.md, "GitHub 会改写你写进 issue/PR 正文的字节"). The code itself uses the real syntax.

## STEP 0 — what does inheriting actually RUN?

Converting a freeze to inheritance loads the real barrel in every converted file, so a barrel with module-scope side effects has those effects restored in ~100 files at once. That is a measurement to take **before** converting, not a risk to discover mid-sweep, and slice 2 paid for the warning: both barrels it swept made 8 module-scope `ComponentRegistry.register` calls each.

`packages/auth/src`'s barrel is 112 lines of re-exports — but "re-exports only by grep" is not the measurement. The whole **static import graph** was walked from `index.ts` and every top-level statement classified. **22 modules**, and exactly **8 module-scope initialisers**, all pure in-memory allocation:

| file:line | what runs at import |
| --- | --- |
| `useWorkspaceAdminStatus.ts:11` | `ADMIN_ROLES` — a `Set` of six literal strings |
| `invitation-status.ts:66` | `AUTH_INVITATION_STATUSES` — `Object.values` of a literal |
| `invitation-status.ts:70` | `STATUS_LOOKUP` — a `Set` over that array |
| `AuthContext.ts:195` | `AuthCtx` — `createContext(null)` |
| `AuthContext.ts:196` | `AuthCtx.displayName = 'AuthContext'` |
| `auth-gate-events.ts:29` | `listeners` — an empty `Set` |
| `ActiveOrganizationStorage.ts:90` | `LEGACY_ACTIVE_ORG_KEY` — an alias of another constant |
| `ActiveOrganizationStorage.ts:109` | `DEVICE_SCOPED_KEYS` — a `Set` of three literals |

And **zero** of the things that would have stopped this slice: no registrations, no timers, no globals, no `fetch`, no storage access at module scope, and no side-effect-only imports. Two column-anchored greps back the AST walk, both returning no match (`grep` exit 1): module-scope touches of `window` / `document` / `globalThis` / `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` / `setTimeout` / `setInterval` / `fetch` / `navigator`, and module-scope `IDENT.register(` / `.init(` / `.configure(` / `.addEventListener(` calls. The five `localStorage` / `window.location` hits in the package are all indented inside function bodies.

⇒ **Inert, and strictly more so than what slice 2 absorbed.** Proceeding, with one independent confirmation: **33 of the 135 judged `@object-ui/auth` sites already inherited the real barrel before this PR** (27 in app-shell, 6 in console) and are green on `main`. The real barrel demonstrably loads in both packages' test environments today; this PR takes that from 33 files to 135.

⛔ That verdict does not generalise to the next barrel. Take the measurement.

## STEP 1 — the derived table

Re-derived with the **fixed** classifier through the guard's exported `scan()` with `covered` set to all 22 workspace specifiers the tree names. ⛔ The constant in the tree was never widened-and-reverted, so there was no window in which a mutated constant could have been committed. Nothing was inherited from the card's table.

| | judged | frozen before | frozen after |
| --- | --: | --: | --: |
| `@object-ui/auth` | 135 | **102** | **0** |

All-specifier population on the sweep's own base `06761b3`: **311 → 209 frozen**, judged unchanged at 640, and **every other one of the 21 rows byte-identical between the two runs** — zero sites moving the other way.

The PM's grep upper bound (135 files: 116 app-shell + 19 console) over-counted, as expected: the actual frozen set is 102 sites, **89 under `packages/app-shell`** and **13 under `apps/console`**.

## STEP 2 — the conversion

Three shapes, all converted to obtain-and-spread with the **spread first**:

- **77 sites** — multi-line object-literal arrow. `() =>` becomes `async (importOriginal) =>` and a spread of `await importOriginal()` (generic argument RECORD-OF-STRING-TO-UNKNOWN) becomes the first property.
- **16 sites** — the same factory written on one line; expanded to the multi-line form so the spread reads as the first property rather than being buried mid-line.
- **9 sites** — block-bodied arrow (`() => { ...; return { ... } }`). The head becomes `async (importOriginal) =>` and the spread becomes the first property of the `return` object, leaving the pre-return locals (a stable `getAuthConfig` identity, a shared `authFetch` double) exactly where they were and doing exactly what they did.

Verification is per file and does not trust the conversion script's exit code: all 102 files parse clean, the spread is confirmed first in all 102, and the gate's own per-file verdict plus both packages' full suites are the actual evidence.

**No site was a deliberate freeze.** Nothing in the 102 was written to prove a module is *not* loaded, so nothing was left converted-blindly or reported as an exception. ⛔ No exemption table, ⛔ no per-site opt-out.

**No file died during collection.** The failure class this worklist exists for did not fire once: app-shell reports the same 632 files / 6077 tests as before the sweep, console the same 89 / 981.

## Residuals — none

- `packages/auth/src/__tests__/auth-spec-parity.test.ts` (held by draft PR #7685) **is not a site** — it carries no `@object-ui/auth` factory, so the exclusion cost nothing.
- Draft PR #7685's 67 files intersect this PR's 102 sites in **zero** paths.
- The three `packages/app-shell/src/views/**` files named for #7307 batch 5 carry no `@object-ui/auth` factory either, and that branch was read over git: it is still an empty branch at `8d40c18`, 0 commits ahead of `main`.

⇒ auth reads **0 frozen** on this tree with nothing held back, so the `COVERED_SPECIFIERS` line ships in full.

## Ablation — six legs, three shapes, from the committed tree

One site per converted shape, two legs each. Mutate by reversing the conversion on that one factory; restore with `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH` under a trap on EXIT INT TERM.

| site | shape | spread marker | mutated gate | restore |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `RecordApprovalsPanel.test.tsx:30` | multi-line | 1 → 0 | exit 1, **1** site line, names this file | blob `5879cb084`, `git diff HEAD` empty, gate exit 0 |
| `FavoritesProvider.test.tsx:15` | was inline | 1 → 0 | exit 1, **1** site line, names this file | blob `041e7c1b9`, `git diff HEAD` empty, gate exit 0 |
| `AppHeader.singleMembershipOrg.test.tsx:131` | block-bodied | 3 → 2 | exit 1, **1** site line, names this file | blob `300b827c7`, `git diff HEAD` empty, gate exit 0 |

The third site is the load-bearing one: that file holds **three** inheriting factories on different specifiers, and the mutation removed exactly one — proof the reversal was surgical rather than a broad delete. Restore is proven by `git hash-object` equalling the HEAD blob **and** an empty `git diff HEAD`, never by a `git checkout` exit code. No dist preflight is needed: the root `vitest.config.mts` aliases `@object-ui/auth` to `packages/auth/src`, and the gate is a source-text scanner.

Both suites were measured at `71250f56b`, the sweep commit. `origin/main` then moved 5 commits and was **merged** (never rebased); the 102 converted files are **byte-identical** between that head and `8d7235c19`, so the suite reading transfers — everything else in the merge is main's own already-landed work. Every gate in the table above was re-run at `8d7235c19`. `Live E2E (informational)` is red on every branch today for an upstream reason (#7990) — not this change.

## One finding worth carrying to slice 4

The merge is a **second observed instance** of slice 2's growth warning, this time *inside a single slice*: in the ~40 minutes between deriving the table and opening this PR, other PRs landed two new frozen sites (`@object-ui/plugin-form`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`) and one new inheriting `@object-ui/react` site. The population reads **211 over 643 judged** on the merged head — none of it auth, which stays at 0. Re-derive per slice, on the merge base, every time. The header records which number belongs to which tree.

Next by yield: `@object-ui/collaboration` (33/33) and `@object-ui/plugin-form` (31/32). `@object-ui/app-shell` (24) still reads #6580 first.
